claims.statement: IRENA and IEA-PVPS project large PV waste volumes and identify reuse, repurposing, and recovery as value opportunities.
EU rules assign producers financing responsibility for collection and treatment of qualifying photovoltaic-panel waste.

contrary_evidence: Falling new-component prices can make reclaimed repairs unattractive.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: seed installers and recyclers, then capture part-number search.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 50 million PLN GMV at 15% take rate supports founder equity above 5 million PLN in six to eight years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15-20 hours weekly with outsourced testing and warehousing.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 45% after inspection and logistics support.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: four repeat technician orders.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 12-20% take rate plus 100-500 PLN testing fees.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: rare parts recur as fleets age.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Completed repairs validate fitment edges while liquidity improves availability
fingerprint.customer: Solar repair technicians, recyclers, and aging-system owners
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Long-tail part-number search and technician procurement
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Fitment-guaranteed exchange earning take rate and testing fees
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The repairer pays when a compatible tested component ships
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A legacy component fails and no economical new replacement exists

founder_fit: Family installers can reveal fitment pain and seed transactions while operations are delegated.
risks: Misidentified components create fire and liability exposure.
Liquidity may fragment by brand and vintage.

structure.control_point: A serial-level fitment, test, failure, and successful-repair graph
structure.critical_dependency: Qualified supply and conservative safety procedures

thesis: A managed B2B exchange for tested reclaimed photovoltaic components builds a compatibility graph from every quoted and completed repair.
title: PV Fitment Exchange
uncertainties: Repair frequency and reclaimable supply quality are unknown.
